pedestrians.title: Video 1 - pedestrians on a campus path
pedestrians.about: Fixed camera looking down on a path. Many people walking in different directions at different distances from the camera.
pedestrians.source: OpenCV sample data, samples/data/vtest.avi (first 30 s, re-encoded to H.264)

store_aisle.title: Video 2 - shoppers in a store aisle
store_aisle.about: Fixed camera looking down an aisle. People walk away from and towards the camera, so they shrink and grow in the image.
store_aisle.source: Intel IoT DevKit sample-videos, store-aisle-detection.mp4 (5 s to 35 s, resampled 60 -> 30 fps, re-encoded to H.264)
